property_summary: For every Put and Collect sequence, the exact-unlockTime boundary must not allow collection: the reference only allows a withdrawal when block.timestamp is strictly greater than acc.unlockTime, so after any successful Collect at exactly the stored unlockTime the balance must remain unchanged; the mutant allows Collect at block.timestamp == acc.unlockTime, so it can reduce the balance and send Ether at exactly that boundary.
change_summary: Changed the unlockTime check from block.timestamp > acc.unlockTime to block.timestamp >= acc.unlockTime, so collection at exactly unlockTime diverges.
